topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 64 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 3 ERC20 tokens, 5 ERC721 NFTs; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin-upgradeable.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 11 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable, guard). Dominant framework: openzeppelin-upgradeable.
